item.text: {"ticker":"SNAP","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation for Snap Inc. The model estimated value per share at $1.03 against a market input of $5.72, using USD and a 10-year N-stage projection. Growth assumes revenue growth of 12.84% in years 2-5, tapering to 4.6% in the terminal year. Margins move from a -4.43% base operating margin to -4.0% next year, then toward a 6.49% target margin. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital of 3.55x in years 1-5 and 1.77x in years 6-10, which means growth consumes meaningful capital before free cash flow turns positive. Cost of capital starts at 10.05% and fades to 9.63% terminally, with a 4.6% risk-free rate and configured Damodaran equity risk premium inputs. Terminal value is $8.37 billion, with present value of terminal value at $3.25 billion, while PV of the first 10 years of FCFF is slightly negative at -$120.4 million. Data caveats: Yahoo Finance coverage can be missing, stale, or insufficient; rates are percentages; sales-to-capital is a multiple; Damodaran reference data maps SNAP to Software (Internet), United States, 2026, with 0.574 confidence; and single-lever market expectation checks vary one assumption at a time."}
